name: Inagi (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Inagi city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a white diagonal stroke, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Inagi, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 October 1967.

features.role: Inagi city emblem — a disc crossed by a white diagonal stroke, like a stylised character
